transformations.description: Copies route and pattern objects from the accepted radial component scenarios, orders routes numerically, and unions StopNodes/StopPlaces by stable ID; any complete-object conflict is a hard failure.
Includes only StopNodes referenced by copied route patterns and only their referenced StopPlaces; no name, proximity or coordinate merge is performed.

Preserves settlement identity fields and derives package-local center/bounds as the union of the corresponding accepted component settlement bounds, matching the approved population-workflow viewport semantics.
Copies component route styles, combines them in numerical route order, and provides one aggregate initial view. Presentation metadata creates no graph semantics.
Adds one catalog descriptor and recomputes all asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from serialized bytes.

warnings: This is a pure merge of accepted Benidorm radial components; no route sequence, pattern, operator identity, coordinate, settlement assignment or StopPlace mapping was rediscovered or normalized during the merge.
No continuous vehicle cycle or reverse pattern is inferred by this merge.
Development-stage coordinates and all component-level coordinate-review warnings are inherited unchanged; the merge creates no new stop position.
The project-owner naming policy uses legacy, while ordered route evidence is a current 2026 capture.
The Line 002 and 003 source pages reflect a temporary July 2026 works routing. This package is a dated topology snapshot, not a claim about the permanent post-works network.
Line 003 has timetable-supported early short workings beginning or ending at VIL 703; they are recorded in provenance and not represented as sequential alternative patterns on the canonical Route.

New FIN and VIL identities are assigned to Finestrat and La Vila Joiosa respectively from the operator composite prefix; exact municipal-boundary review remains appropriate for mixed Cala corridor stops.
New address/corridor and interpolated coordinates are explicitly provisional. Identity-preserving exact-source replacement is required before treating geography as authoritative.
Different composite stop codes remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names or positions are close.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform/stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
